note: The source wiki being hard to read is the reason this project exists, so 'visibly different from it' is a requirement with its own rows rather than a side effect of choosing nice fonts. Every failing below was observed in the live source; every row names its counter-treatment and the paired capture that shows it. Reviewer opinion does not close a row.
tuple: 390x844, deviceScaleFactor 2, mobile, same article, both sides

rows.sourceDoes: At a 390px phone viewport the article is pushed off to the right behind a persistent icon sidebar and a large advertising slot; the page itself scrolls sideways.
rows.weDo: No sidebar, no advertising, nothing third-party. The article starts at the top of the viewport and the page body never scrolls sideways — asserted at five viewports by scripts/verify-built-site.mjs.

rows.sourceDoes: The front page is a centred wall of giant image buttons plus an embedded chat widget, with no reading structure.
rows.weDo: A category grid with live article counts and a factual introduction. No embeds.

rows.sourceDoes: The infobox is a right-floating aside that overflows a narrow screen.
rows.weDo: A Key facts card that sits above the prose on a phone and beside it when there is room.

rows.sourceDoes: Every heading carries an mw-editsection pencil and a sign-in link.
rows.weDo: Stripped at import. Headings are headings, and scripts/build-articles.mjs refuses to write a body containing source chrome.

rows.sourceDoes: Headings embed decorative images as icons, so a heading reads '[picture of a dollar] Selling Price'.
rows.weDo: Text headings. Decorative art inside a heading is removed; meaningful art is kept with real alt text.

rows.sourceDoes: Prices are signalled by an inline colour span, so colour is the only carrier.
rows.weDo: Tabular lining numerals with aligned units in the Key facts card. Colour is never the only signal.

rows.sourceDoes: Line length is unbounded on a wide screen.
rows.weDo: The prose column is capped near 68 characters, measured from computed styles on the running page rather than asserted.

rows.sourceDoes: Facts live inside each article's own template, so no reader can compare items across articles.
rows.weDo: Seventeen sortable comparison tables built from typed infobox records — a view the source cannot produce at all.

rows.sourceDoes: Documents logic components in prose; a reader can learn what a gate does but cannot try one.
rows.weDo: A logic lab that builds and runs circuits from those same documented parts.
